candidate_matrix.title: Altair RD-E 2602 Ductile Failure Model

authoritative_primary_provenance.reason: The exact input archive was acquired from the official Altair 2025 endpoint and matched the predeclared content length.

lawful_open_access_and_license.reason: Public download is verified, but no reusable model-file license is embedded; the official documentation page carries an All Rights Reserved notice.

bounded_downloadable_deck_or_reconstruct.reason: The small complete Radioss Starter/Engine decks are present and locally inspectable.

failure_and_regularization_complete.reason: Failure cards are present, but objective regularization is inactive or absent: BIQUAD Ref.El_Length is zero, TAB1 has no active element-length function and no /NONLOCAL card exists.

measured_validation_outputs.reason: The archive contains no measured force, impulse, residual velocity, deformation or perforation dataset.

mesh_and_convergence_definition.reason: The archive contains formulation and shell-option variants, not three documented mesh levels with a common convergence observable.

local_execution_feasible_and_bounded.reason: The small decks are compatible with the available OpenRadioss route and are expected to run within the bounded CPU limit; V9L intentionally does not execute them.

candidate_matrix.title: Explicit Finite Element Analysis of 2024-T3/T351 Aluminum Material Under Impact Loading for Airplane Engine Containment and Fragment Shielding

authoritative_primary_provenance.reason: The inspected report self-identifies as the FAA final report DOT/FAA/AR-08/36 with government sponsorship and public distribution.

lawful_open_access_and_license.reason: The report is public, but no solver deck or explicit model-file reuse license is supplied; report access alone does not license a benchmark deck.

bounded_downloadable_deck_or_reconstruct.reason: Geometry, material tables and contact choices are informative, but the exact meshes, complete boundary/input data and LS-DYNA deck are not published for deterministic reconstruction.

failure_and_regularization_complete.reason: Johnson-Cook damage parameters are listed, but they are calibrated to element size and thickness; the nonlocal length is not numerically fixed and did not remove mesh dependency.

measured_validation_outputs.reason: The report exposes measured initial and residual velocities with units and test geometry for three target thicknesses, although measurement uncertainty is absent.

mesh_and_convergence_definition.reason: Three meshes are compared, but Mesh-III changes the in-plane topology and the study reports sensitivity rather than a converged sequence or numerical uncertainty bound.

local_execution_feasible_and_bounded.reason: The LS-DYNA deck is absent, the solver route is proprietary, and no documented deterministic OpenRadioss conversion is supplied.

controlling_rejection_reasons: The report is public, but no solver deck or explicit model-file reuse license is supplied; report access alone does not license a benchmark deck.
Geometry, material tables and contact choices are informative, but the exact meshes, complete boundary/input data and LS-DYNA deck are not published for deterministic reconstruction.
Johnson-Cook damage parameters are listed, but they are calibrated to element size and thickness; the nonlocal length is not numerically fixed and did not remove mesh dependency.
Three meshes are compared, but Mesh-III changes the in-plane topology and the study reports sensitivity rather than a converged sequence or numerical uncertainty bound.
The LS-DYNA deck is absent, the solver route is proprietary, and no documented deterministic OpenRadioss conversion is supplied.

stop_rule.pass_rule: At most one benchmark may pass, and only if every unchanged gate is directly supported by inspected primary material.
stop_rule.negative_rule: If no inspected target combines measured quantitative validation, objective failure regularization and an explicit three-level convergence definition with a lawful executable or reconstructible model, record a validated negative result and close the external benchmark search.
